"""Independent engine/order/raw audit and predeclared conditional changed-reply statistics."""
from __future__ import annotations
import collections, gzip, hashlib, importlib.util, json, math, pathlib, sys, time
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import numpy as np
R=pathlib.Path.cwd();O=R/'build/t0013_changed';P=R/'bots/p_only/report/p_features/changed_reply'
sys.path.insert(0,str(R))
from fusion import matchlog
from fusion.protocol import parse_reply, parse_block
def h(p):return hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def d(x):return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(x,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode()).hexdigest()
def read(p):return json.loads(pathlib.Path(p).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def save(p,x):
 p=pathlib.Path(p);p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);tmp=p.with_name(p.name+'.tmp');tmp.write_text(json.dumps(x,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8');tmp.replace(p)
def utc():return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
def utility(scores,seat):return sum(1.0 if scores[seat]>s else .5 if scores[seat]==s else 0 for i,s in enumerate(scores) if i!=seat)/(len(scores)-1)
def engine():
 spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('audit_engine',O/'engine.py');mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(mod);return mod

def main():
 start=time.perf_counter();plan=read(O/'PLAN.json');identity=plan['identity']
 assert d({k:v for k,v in plan.items() if k!='identity'})==identity
 assert read(O/'COMPLETE.json')['identity']==identity
 if (O/'AUDIT_COMPLETE.json').exists():raise RuntimeError('Successful audit complete; never repeat')
 lease=read(pathlib.Path.home()/'.ctf-fusion/locks/cpu.json');assert lease['task']=='T0013' and 't0013_changed_audit_run.ps1' in lease['command']
 assert not (pathlib.Path.home()/'.ctf-fusion/locks/gpu.json').exists()
 assert h(O/'engine.py')==plan['engine_sha256']
 for path,sha in plan['execution_sources'].items():assert h(R/path)==sha
 for name,sha in plan['helper_sources'].items():assert h(R.parents[1]/name)==sha
 for b in plan['binaries'].values():assert h(R/b['command'][0])==b['binary_sha256']
 eng=engine();matches={};raw={};physical=0;live_faults=all_faults=prefix_faults=root_faults=0;prefix_mismatch=0;total_turns=0;roots_bykey={r['key']:r for r in plan['roots']}
 raw_bindings=[];significant_fault_rows=[]
 for s in plan['states']:
  assert h(R/s['path'])==s['sha256'];matches[s['fixture_id']]=matchlog.load(R/s['path'])
 for r in plan['roots']:
  m=matches[r['fixture_id']]
  for c,line in enumerate(r['candidates']):
   values=[]
   for k in range(3):
    path=O/'raw'/r['key']/f'c{c}-r{k}.json.gz';rec=read(path.with_suffix(path.suffix+'.receipt.json'));assert h(path)==rec['sha256'] and rec['identity']==identity
    row=json.load(gzip.open(path,'rt',encoding='utf-8'));assert row['identity']==identity and row['root']==r and row['candidate']==c and row['repeat']==k and row['line']==line
    assert row['master']==plan['master'] and row['map_seed']==m['map_seed'] and row['flag_seed']==m['flag_seed']
    assert row['limits_ms']==[2000,50] and row['prefix_limit_ms']==5000 and len(row['trace'])==400
    g=eng.Game(m['teams'],m['map_seed'],flag_seed=m['flag_seed']);faultlist=[];live=[];mismatches=pf=0
    for t,trace in enumerate(row['trace'],1):
     assert t==trace['turn'];block=g.encode(0)
     if t==1:
      ini,block=matchlog.split_init(block);assert ini==m['init']
     assert block==trace['block']
     if t<=r['turn']:assert block==m['blocks'][t-1]
     if t==r['turn']:assert row['root_block']==block
     if t==r['turn']+1:assert row['next_block']==block
     expected=trace['computed']
     if t<r['turn']:
      expected=m['replies'][t-1];mismatches+=sum(a!=b for a,b in zip(trace['computed'],expected));pf+=len({x[1] for x in trace['faults']})
     elif t==r['turn']:
      expected=list(m['replies'][t-1]);expected[r['seat']]=line
     assert trace['used']==expected and len(expected)==m['teams']
     orders={};errors=[]
     for i,ln in enumerate(trace['used']):
      if ln is None:orders[i]={};continue
      try:orders[i]=g.decode(i,ln)
      except ValueError as exc:orders[i]={};errors.append([i,str(exc)])
     if t>=r['turn']:assert errors==trace['decode_errors']
     assert all(x[0]==t and 0<=x[1]<m['teams'] for x in trace['faults']);faultlist+=trace['faults']
     if t>r['turn']:live+=trace['faults']
     g.step(orders)
    assert g.done and g.encode(0)==row['final_block'] and g.result()==row['result'] and g.result()['score']==row['score']
    assert parse_block(row['final_block']).score==row['score'] and row['outcome']==utility(row['score'],r['seat'])
    assert row['prefix_mismatch']==mismatches and row['prefix_faults']==pf and row['faults']==live
    assert sorted(faultlist)==sorted(row['all_phase_faults'])
    if r['turn']==400:assert row['next_block'] is None
    physical+=1;total_turns+=400;live_faults+=len(live);all_faults+=len(faultlist);prefix_faults+=sum(x[0]<r['turn'] for x in faultlist);root_faults+=sum(x[0]==r['turn'] for x in faultlist);prefix_mismatch+=mismatches
    if faultlist:significant_fault_rows.append({'root':r['key'],'candidate':c,'repeat':k,'faults':faultlist})
    values.append(row['outcome']);raw_bindings.append({'path':str(path.relative_to(R)).replace('\\','/'),'sha256':rec['sha256'],'root_key':r['key'],'candidate':c,'repeat':k})
   raw[(r['key'],c)]=values
  save(O/'audit_state.json',{'utc':utc(),'identity':identity,'audited_roots':len({x['root_key'] for x in raw_bindings}),'audited_continuations':physical,'stage':'strict_raw_audit'})
 assert physical==plan['unique_physical_continuations'] and len(list((O/'raw').rglob('*.json.gz')))==physical
 paired=[];summary={}
 for group in ['near','far']:
  rows=[];variance=[]
  for pair in plan['pairs']:
   if pair['group']!=group:continue
   root=roots_bykey[pair['root_key']];a=np.array(raw[(root['key'],pair['a'])]);b=np.array(raw[(root['key'],pair['b'])]);delta=float(b.mean()-a.mean())
   row={**pair,'teams':root['teams'],'map_seed':root['map_seed'],'turn':root['turn'],'a_outcomes':a.tolist(),'b_outcomes':b.tolist(),'delta':delta,
       'a_sample_variance':float(a.var(ddof=1)),'b_sample_variance':float(b.var(ddof=1)),'paired_repeat_sample_variance':float((b-a).var(ddof=1))}
   rows.append(row);paired.append(row);variance.append(row)
  counts=sorted({x['teams'] for x in rows});by_count={n:[x for x in rows if x['teams']==n] for n in counts}
  means=[sum(x['delta'] for x in by_count[n])/len(by_count[n]) for n in counts];mu=sum(means)/len(means)
  percount=[{'teams':n,'roots':len(by_count[n]),'maps':len({x['map_seed'] for x in by_count[n]}),'delta':v} for n,v in zip(counts,means)]
  ci=None;bootstrap=None
  if group=='near':
   assert counts==list(range(3,16)) and all(x['maps']==2 for x in percount)
   rngseed=int(identity[:16],16);rng=np.random.default_rng(rngseed);draws=np.zeros(5000);independent=np.zeros(5000)
   for n in counts:
    clusters=sorted({x['map_seed'] for x in by_count[n]});sums=np.array([sum(x['delta'] for x in by_count[n] if x['map_seed']==m) for m in clusters]);sizes=np.array([sum(x['map_seed']==m for x in by_count[n]) for m in clusters]);pick=rng.integers(0,2,size=(5000,2))
    draws+=sums[pick].sum(axis=1)/sizes[pick].sum(axis=1)/13
    # Separate loop arithmetic checks equal-count denominator and duplicate-cluster weighting.
    for j,(a,b) in enumerate(pick):independent[j]+=(float(sums[a])+float(sums[b]))/(int(sizes[a])+int(sizes[b]))/13
   assert np.max(np.abs(draws-independent))<1e-14
   ci=[float(x) for x in np.quantile(draws,[.025,.975])];bootstrap={'draws':5000,'rng_seed':rngseed,'method':'stratified within-count map-cluster percentile; all roots of selected maps; fixed-count means then equal13 counts','independent_arithmetic_parity':True,'draw_sha256':hashlib.sha256(draws.tobytes()).hexdigest()}
  verdict='not shown' if ci is None or ci[0]<=0<=ci[1] else 'conditional mean improvement shown' if ci[0]>0 else 'conditional mean worsening shown'
  summary[group]={'roots':len(rows),'counts':len(counts),'maps':len({(x['teams'],x['map_seed']) for x in rows}),'equal_count_delta':mu,'root_weighted_delta_context':sum(x['delta'] for x in rows)/len(rows),
      'ci95':ci,'bootstrap':bootstrap,'ci_unavailable_reason':None if ci else 'six of nine count strata have only one changed-root map; within-count map uncertainty is not identified',
      'per_count':percount,'root_sign_counts':{'positive':sum(x['delta']>1e-12 for x in rows),'negative':sum(x['delta']<-1e-12 for x in rows),'zero':sum(abs(x['delta'])<=1e-12 for x in rows)},
      'repeat_diagnostics':{'mean_A_sample_variance':sum(x['a_sample_variance'] for x in rows)/len(rows),'mean_B_sample_variance':sum(x['b_sample_variance'] for x in rows)/len(rows),'mean_paired_repeat_sample_variance':sum(x['paired_repeat_sample_variance'] for x in rows)/len(rows),'actions_with_three_equal_outcomes':sum(len(set(x[role+'_outcomes']))==1 for x in rows for role in ['a','b']),'all_action_sets':2*len(rows),'assumption':'three repeats retain original flag stream; sample variance is actual repeat variability, not IID noise proof'},'verdict':verdict}
 audit={'utc':utc(),'identity':identity,'pass':True,'physical_continuations':physical,'roots':483,'turn_blocks':total_turns,
    'score_utility_engine_step_protocol_source_binary_receipts_exact':True,'all_phase_faults':all_faults,'prefix_faults':prefix_faults,'discarded_root_computed_faults':root_faults,'live_faults':live_faults,'prefix_reply_mismatches':prefix_mismatch,
    'fault_retention':'all completed trajectories/outcomes kept; no exclusions or favorable reruns','fault_rows':significant_fault_rows,'raw_receipts_digest':d(raw_bindings),'raw_receipts':raw_bindings,'seconds':time.perf_counter()-start}
 stats={'utc':utc(),'identity':identity,'groups':summary,'pairs':paired,'scope':'conditional changed roots under common frozen P2 continuation; not full-game P3 strength or unique causal mechanism; root sign counts are noisy repeat estimates','dependence':'same26 T13 source maps; near/far share2 roots; no independence claim'}
 save(O/'INDEPENDENT_AUDIT.json',audit);save(P/'INDEPENDENT_AUDIT.json',audit);save(O/'RESULTS.json',stats);save(P/'RESULTS.json',stats)
 near=summary['near'];far=summary['far'];sign=near['root_sign_counts']
 text=f'''# C08 changed-reply counterfactual results

Generated by t0013_changed_audit.py from retained full branch trajectories. Frozen identity `{identity}`.

Near primary: count-equally-weighted delta {near['equal_count_delta']:+.6f}, map-clustered95% CI {near['ci95']}. {near['verdict']}. The estimated root signs are {sign['positive']} positive, {sign['negative']} negative and {sign['zero']} zero, using three outcomes per candidate. These signs do not establish the true better action for each root.

465 near pairs cover13 counts and26 maps (two maps/count). Far secondary:20 pairs across9 counts and12 maps, count-equally-weighted delta {far['equal_count_delta']:+.6f}. Fixed-count cluster CI unavailable: six count strata have a single map with changed roots. Far is coverage-limited and separate. Two identical pairs overlap, so485 statistical pairs use483 unique root states and{physical} unique continuations; shared exact runs are reused.

Both candidates continue with the same frozen P2 C08/Voff policy. A is the fixed128 deadline-off diagnostic P2 reply, not necessarily the recorded timed reply. B is the near/far branch-only P3 reply with rootP2 unchanged. Recorded engine/order prefix and opponents' t replies are held fixed, own t reply is forced, then all seats are live. Computed root-choice bot memory is retained as in stock branch_collect. Master20261260 schedules work only; original map/flag streams are retained and repeats are not independent RNG replications.

Independent audit re-stepped all{total_turns} turn blocks, checked prefixes/root/usedorders/final score/utility/fault and physical-run receipts. Live faults {live_faults}; all-phase faults {all_faults}, including prefix {prefix_faults} and discarded computed-root {root_faults}. Prefix computed-reply mismatches {prefix_mismatch}; all outcomes remain in their denominators. Full repeat variances, per-count support and raw receipt hashes are in RESULTS.json/INDEPENDENT_AUDIT.json.

A positive/negative interval concerns conditional mean utility of these changed actions under this continuation policy. It does not identify deadline tax as the sole cause, saturation or misuse, prove that a majority of roots improved, approve P3 deployment, or establish actor superiority. A zero-overlapping interval means advantage not shown. Root selection uses T13 maps, so this study is not independent of the full screen. No training/export/default or v12 result.
'''
 (P/'RESULTS.md').write_text(text,encoding='utf-8')
 save(O/'AUDIT_COMPLETE.json',{'utc':utc(),'identity':identity,'success':True,'audit_sha256':h(O/'INDEPENDENT_AUDIT.json'),'results_sha256':h(O/'RESULTS.json')})
 save(O/'audit_state.json',{'utc':utc(),'identity':identity,'stage':'audit_and_statistics_complete','physical_continuations':physical})
 print(json.dumps({'audit_pass':True,'physical':physical,'live_faults':live_faults,'near':{k:v for k,v in near.items() if k in ['equal_count_delta','ci95','root_sign_counts','verdict']},'far_delta':far['equal_count_delta']}),flush=True)
if __name__=='__main__':main()

t0013_changed_audit_run.ps1.text:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$root=(Get-Location).Path
$self=Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId=$PID"
$parent=Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId=$($self.ParentProcessId)"
if ($parent.CommandLine -notmatch 'task.py lock.*T0013.*t0013_changed_audit_run.ps1') { throw 'Unverified CPU lock parent' }
$lease=Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.ctf-fusion/locks/cpu.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
if ($lease.pid -ne $parent.ProcessId -or $lease.task -ne 'T0013') { throw 'Wrong CPU lease' }
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.ctf-fusion/locks/gpu.json')) { throw 'GPU lease present; no formal CPU/GPU concurrency' }
$created=$parent.CreationDate.ToUniversalTime().ToString('o')
@{pipeline_pid=$parent.ProcessId;created_utc=$created;source_commit='a729122464151e96020389bfa02e0f809a6c64cd';helper_pid=$PID} |
    ConvertTo-Json | Set-Content -LiteralPath 'build/t0013_changed_audit/pipeline_pid.json' -Encoding utf8
if (-not $env:T0013_PYTHON) { throw 'T0013_PYTHON must name the verified interpreter' }
$watch=Start-Process -FilePath 'pwsh.exe' -ArgumentList @('-NoProfile','-ExecutionPolicy','Bypass','-File','../../t0013_changed_audit_monitor.ps1',
    '-RepoPath',$root,'-PipelinePid',[string]$parent.ProcessId,'-CreationUtc',$created,'-ExpectedCommandTag','t0013_changed_audit_run.ps1') `
    -WindowStyle Hidden -RedirectStandardOutput 'build/t0013_changed_audit/resource_monitor.stdout' `
    -RedirectStandardError 'build/t0013_changed_audit/resource_monitor.stderr' -PassThru
@{monitor_pid=$watch.Id;created_utc=$watch.StartTime.ToUniversalTime().ToString('o');pipeline_pid=$parent.ProcessId} |
    ConvertTo-Json | Set-Content -LiteralPath 'build/t0013_changed_audit/resource_monitor_pid.json' -Encoding utf8
& $env:T0013_PYTHON ../../t0013_changed_audit.py
exit $LASTEXITCODE
